title: Automations
description: Does what an automation says when it comes due: the kernel's clock tells it an automation's time has come, and it makes the notification, about what the automation is about. It owns no type: core's automation type is what it acts on.

rules.say: Each firing of an automation: what occurrence it answered, as which version, and what it made. Every one kept, so a firing can be measured and replayed by version.
